description: The file defines API route handlers for an insurance fraud detection system, including health checks, claims upload, claims listing and detail, outcome submission, investigator queue, and reports summary. It uses Express.js routing, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and references external controllers for actual logic.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the root path, performing a health check via healthController.

methods.name: router.post('/api/claims/upload')
methods.description: Handles POST requests for uploading claims CSV files, delegating processing to claimsController.uploadCsv.

methods.name: router.get('/api/claims')
methods.description: Lists claims with optional search, filtering, and sorting parameters, handled by claimsController.listClaims.

methods.name: router.get('/api/claims/:id')
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific claim, including associated fraud signals, via claimsController.getClaim.

methods.name: router.post('/api/claims/:id/outcome')
methods.description: Submits investigation outcomes for a claim, updating its status and outcome, handled by claimsController.submitOutcome.

methods.name: router.get('/api/queue')
methods.description: Retrieves the investigator queue with prioritization, handled by claimsController.queue.

methods.name: router.get('/api/reports/summary')
methods.description: Provides a summary report of claims metrics, managed by claimsController.reportsSummary.
